description: Formula/*.rb is generated by the release automation, so the homebrew manager stays off: edits there are overwritten at the next release.

packageRules.description: rustls 0.23.44 requires aws-lc-rs ^1.18, but mls-rs-crypto-awslc pins aws-lc-rs = "=1.16.2" and we reach it through a2a-slimrpc -> agntcy-slim-auth. Cargo cannot satisfy both, so the precise lockfile bump Renovate runs for this group aborts and every Cargo dependency PR fails renovate/artifacts. Capped until the upstream pin is relaxed; see https://github.com/a2aproject/a2a-rs/issues/227. Not expressed in Cargo.toml on purpose: the conflict is a property of this workspace, and an upper bound there would constrain downstream crates that do not depend on slimrpc.
The SLIM crates must move together: slim_auth 0.14 caps below 0.15 while slim_rpc 2.3 requires it, which puts two versions in the tree and breaks the TokenProvider bounds.
Workspace crates are released by the repo's own automation.
Low-risk bumps in one PR to keep the review load down.
